description: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of time spent on different stages of a question-answering process, categorized by percentile. The horizontal axis represents the categories, labeled as "Avg.", "50%", and "75%", indicating average, 50th percentile, and 75th percentile, respectively, and is not explicitly scaled. The vertical axis is labeled "sec." and represents time in seconds, with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 8.0 seconds, marked at intervals of 2.0 seconds. Each category is represented by a stacked bar, comprising four segments corresponding to "Search", "Fetch", "Extract", and "Retrieval" stages, colored in dark blue, blue, light blue, and pale blue, respectively. The "Search" segment is consistently the largest component across all categories, with values of approximately 1.8, 1.4, and 2.0 seconds for "Avg.", "50%", and "75%" categories, respectively. The total height of the bars increases from "50%" to "75%", with the "50%" category having the shortest bar at around 3.2 seconds and the "75%" category having the tallest bar at approximately 8.8 seconds. The bars are not sorted in any particular order other than their categorical sequence. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding.
